title: Umuhinga mu vy'ubwubatsi bw'Icipfuzo c'Ikinyoma
intro: Umuntu yari afise ubukuru bukomeye yigeze gukorera umwe mu banyagitugu bazwi cane kuruta abandi bose mu mateka mu Misiri ya kera. Uwo muntu yari yajejwe itegeko ry’ubushizi bw’amanga — ryo kwubaka ikibanza cari gifise intumbero yo gutera umugongo ijuru. Inkuru yabo ihagaze muri Korowani nk’icigwa gitangaje ku kuntu kwumvira ubwibone ata co bimaze bijana gusa mu gusenyuka.
clues: Nakorera mu bigo vy’umutware w’inkomezi yivugira ko ari we afise ubumana ku bihugu.
Nari mfise ikibanza gikomeye c’ubusuku, nkagira inama umunyagitugu w’ubwibone kuruta abandi bose bo mu gihe canje.
Umutware wanje yari afise umutima wo gutera umugere Imana ya Musa, iyo banse kwemera.
Nategetswe kwubaka umunara w’amatafari yoshejwe n’umuriro kugira ngo umutware wanje ashobore kuduga mw’ijuru.
Uwo munara ntiwigeze ushika mw’ijuru, kandi ubuja bwanje bw’ubwibone bwatumye ngira isoni z’ibihe bidahera.
Narazimanganye n’uwo nakurikiye, izina ryanje rikaba imburi ihoraho ku bashoboza abanyagitugu.

Bajugunywe mu muriro ururumba nk’ikigeragezo c’ukwizera .
